headline: Frontier Ledgers Show Renewed Base Turns
war_summary: Since the last edition, the ownership ledger has shifted in several contested sectors. Lykos Isle, which had one Warden base, now lists all seven as Colonial-held. Callum’s Cape is divided three to three, with one base neutral, where the previous count showed four Warden bases and none neutral. Marban Hollow has also tightened to three bases apiece, with two neutral; it stood at five Colonial, two Warden and one neutral. The fronts at Linn Mercy, Mooring County and Weathered Expanse retain their previous control totals, but remain busy: the latest two-hour tally records three, six and six events respectively. Callum’s Cape recorded two, while Marban logged three. Lykos Isle saw five events in that span, accompanying the changed balance. Heavy recent casualty increments in Mooring County, Callum’s Cape, Linn Mercy and Weathered Expanse underscore the activity, though they do not alone establish who will hold bases next. Stonecradle remains wholly Colonial-held and has been quiet in the latest hours. The war remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
